result.summary: The page is broadly coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel is visually broken — its cards have inconsistent heights, vertical offsets and badge placements — and several styling inconsistencies appear in the 'Popular right now' list. Found 6 issues (1 major layout defect plus supporting issues).

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned to a common baseline: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image is shorter and sits higher, 'Smash Bros Burgers' is pushed ~40px lower, and 'Trattoria Piccol…' sits higher again. Titles and delivery-fee lines therefore appear at three different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items a fixed image aspect ratio/height and align them in a single row with consistent top alignment and equal card heights.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is clipped by the bottom tab bar, showing only the image with no restaurant name, rating or delivery info, which makes it look like a rendering error rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll container equal to the tab bar height so cards are never cut off mid-content.

issues.description: Time badges are inconsistently placed and styled across carousel cards: on 'Green Bowl Poké' it hugs the bottom-left edge with no visible padding, while on the other cards it is inset differently, and the Poké image background is washed-out grey vs. the dark photos of its neighbours.
issues.suggestion: Standardise badge offset (e.g. 8–12px from bottom-left) and use consistent image treatment/overlay for all cards.

issues.description: The third carousel card's name is truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, and the card itself is cut by the viewport edge, giving no visual cue that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis and show a partial-card peek or fade/arrow affordance to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card's heart is a bare white outline over a dark image, while the pizza card's heart sits inside a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Use the same heart button treatment (e.g. always a translucent circular backdrop) on every card for legibility and consistency.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' metadata line uses light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast minimum; the notification bell dot also has no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast and add an accessible label/count to the notification indicator.
